summary: preinstall reverse shell and canarytoken beacon in @nimbusedge/auth
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs on `npm install` and executes an interactive bash reverse shell to 147.93.157.202:8080 via /dev/tcp, piping the session through an HTTP POST to a canarytokens.com URL. The scoped name and implausibly high version (19999.0.2) match the dependency-confusion shape, in which the published package wins resolution against an internal package of the same name and the preinstall payload runs on any host that installs it. No legitimate build behavior is present; the package's only on-install effect is remote shell access to the installer's host and an outbound beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
